info.name: Bloom Express API — private optional cloud backup
info.description: Runs locally with fictional aliases and an actual browser-encrypted fictional diary. No real health data or personal credentials belong in this collection. Collection order matters: register two disposable users, verify isolation and revisions, then delete both accounts. Run against a disposable test database whenever possible. The server validates the encrypted envelope shape; only the browser can verify/decrypt its content.
